## Data Product Overview
Seasonal influenza vaccination is a critical component of NHS resilience, reducing unplanned hospital admissions and pressures on urgent care. The Advanced Service Flu Report – Pharmacy Contractors in ePACT2 provides monthly data on the number of flu vaccinations administered by community pharmacies under the NHS advanced service specification.

This report includes details such as pharmacy contractor information, vaccine type, manufacturer, quantity administered, and associated fees. It enables commissioners and NHS England to monitor uptake of flu vaccinations, assess service delivery against targets, and identify trends across regions. Users can filter data by time period and contractor, supporting performance management and strategic planning.

This report aims to promote transparency and support the national influenza immunisation programme by providing accurate and timely data on pharmacy-delivered vaccinations. It helps organisations evaluate the contribution of community pharmacies to vaccination coverage, identify areas for improvement, and ensure equitable access for eligible patients. While the report provides essential operational data, it should be used alongside other public health dashboards to inform decisions and improve outcomes. It intends to support NHS objectives for flu prevention and strengthen system resilience during seasonal pressures.
